query:
-- AL Senate: Both parties going to June 16 runoff
UPDATE senate_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'Everett Wess → Dakarai Larriett (D Runoff, June 16)',
  candidate2_name = 'Barry Moore → Jared Hudson (R Runoff, June 16)'
WHERE state_code = 'AL';

-- GA Senate: Jon Ossoff won D primary uncontested; R runoff is Collins vs Dooley (June 16)
UPDATE senate_races SET 
  status = 'Primary Runoff',
  candidate1_name = 'Jon Ossoff (D, uncontested)',
  candidate2_name = 'Mike Collins → Derek Dooley (R Runoff, June 16)'
WHERE state_code = 'GA';

-- LA Senate: R runoff Letlow vs Fleming; D runoff Jamie Davis vs Gary Crockett
UPDATE senate_races SET 
  candidate1_name = 'Julia Letlow → John Fleming (R Runoff, June 16)',
  candidate2_name = 'Jamie Davis → Gary Crockett (D Runoff, June 16)',
  candidate2_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'LA';

-- TX Senate: Add Democratic candidate James Talarico
UPDATE senate_races SET 
  candidate1_name = 'James Talarico',
  candidate1_party = 'D'
WHERE state_code = 'TX';

SELECT state_code, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party 
FROM senate_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('AL','GA','LA','TX')
ORDER BY state_code;
